statement: Golden foods are bonuses added to characters via food slots but can never be consumed; they are permanent and movable between characters.
Golden food has diminishing returns: more pieces in a stack give less per piece; 1 piece gives 1.3% base stats and 10 give 6%.
Diminishing returns continue to about 100000 pieces where the bonus is only about 65%; it scales past that but gives little per piece.
The golden beanstalk makes all golden foods active across the whole account so you do not choose which character gets which stack.
The beanstalk is unlocked through the Jade Emporium with the sneaking skill and has two upgrades.
The first upgrade (golden food beanstalk) lets you deposit 10000 of a specific golden food to permanently gain its bonus.
The more expensive super sized golden bean stacking upgrade allows depositing another 100000 for 110000 total pieces per golden food.
With super sized version the golden food bonus shows larger and increases; his golden girl cheese gives 65% to all stats account-wide.
Golden nom witches drop from the rare drop table of world 1 mobs; farm by killing boar beans with Divine Knight crystal farming.
Boar beans and crystal mobs both have golden nom witches on their rare or mega rare drop table so any world 1 mob can drop it.
Crystal farming also drops hot dogs which are needed to craft golden peanuts.
Each peanut needs 2 hot dogs and each golden peanut needs 100 peanuts so 200 hot dogs per golden peanut; crystal farming stacks materials.
Golden jam raises max health; best farmed in the world 1 Coliseum with about one minute per run.
Golden jams drop from the golden chest at the end of the world 1 Coliseum and golden nom witches from the other chests.
One Coliseum run gave about 80 to 90 golden jam; a quick method if you have enough Coliseum tickets.
The daily picnic stowaway quest gives 38 golden jam and 34 golden kebabs each day.
Picnic stowaway can be done on each of up to 10 characters daily but is limited by sculpting tools; only 6 buyable per day in world 1 shop.
Golden kebab gives a percent to total damage.
Farm golden kebabs in the world 2 Coliseum; dropped by silver chests at the end and limited only by tickets.
World 2 Coliseum golden chest also gives a small chance of golden meat pies so you double up on golden foods.
Golden meat pie increases total defense by a percent.
Best method for golden meat pie is Divine Knight crystal farming in the Sandy Pots (snel) map; he recommends it over the Coliseum.
Sandy pots have golden meat pie and drop rate obols on the mega rare table; crystal mobs share this table making it a great stacking method.
Butter bar increases base accuracy on characters.
Butter bars are not a bad thing to have in early world 6 as accuracy helps get through world 6 maps easier.
Butter bars drop as a rare skilling drop from AFK butterflies at 1 in 100; takes some time away from killing mobs.
Divine Knight crystal farm the Neptune map in world 3 to get golden ham (skill exp) and golden cheese (shrine leveling) together.
Golden cheese is important for the beanstalk since it is generally not worth equipping on characters.
Golden ham and golden cheese are on Neptune rare drops and mega rare drops.
Golden bread boosts coin drops from mobs; farm as soon as you can to level stamps and other things.
Golden bread only drops from the golden chest in the world 3 Chillsnap Coliseum so you need to clear it at a decent rate.
Coliseum is the only way to farm golden bread so save up Coliseum tickets to farm it as much as possible.
Golden kebabs may be worth farming before spending time in the world 3 Coliseum.
Golden ribs raise fishing efficiency by a large amount; farm with Divine Knight crystal farming at the clams in world 4.
Clam farming also gets pearl shellers and statues; pearl shellers craft gear and weapons and upgrade a violin.
Golden hamper gummy candy gives a chance at more AFK sailing gains when claiming; get via DK crystal farm at trimmer worms.
Golden grilled cheese nwit is one of the best golden foods giving percent to four base stats (strength agility wisdom luck); from trimmer worms.
Golden dumpling and golden ngiri come from DK crystal farming at mini chiefs
Golden dumpling increases all AFK gain rates
explicit: a huge bonus combined with the beanstalk.

statement: Golden ngiri increases class exp gain and is huge with the beanstalk.
Farm all golden foods up to 110000 each to fill the beanstalk.
There are six bonuses that multiply golden food effect; his total adds up to 681%.
Golden apple stamp gives about 1% golden food bonus per level; it requires golden nom witches so farm boar beans in world 1.
Shimmeron
confidence: gives up to 80% more golden food effect depending on bubble level.

statement: The emoji veggie sigil gives up to 25% more bonus from golden foods.
Yummy peach ring dinner menu meal gives 2% golden food bonus per level; level 61 gives 122%.
Shaman family bonus multiplies golden foods; his is 1.34x at class level 617 and varies with class levels.
Hungry for gold is a warrior talent for Blood Berserkers and Divine Knights multiplying golden foods; his gives 44%.
